description: This file defines configuration utilities and error handling for setting up and managing camera sessions using AVFoundation in a Swift project. It includes functions to add inputs and outputs to an AVCaptureSession and an enum for capturing possible configuration errors.

methods.name: addCameraInput(session:camera:)
methods.description: Adds an AVCaptureDeviceInput for the specified camera to the given capture session.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput(session:)
methods.description: Creates and adds an AVCapturePhotoOutput to the session, configuring photo quality prioritization.

methods.name: addMovieOutput(session:includeAudio:durationMs:)
methods.description: Creates and adds an AVCaptureMovieFileOutput to the session, optionally including microphone input and setting maximum recording duration.
